standard.summary: 学习一个按 sigma 的不确定度 u(σ)，损失变为 loss
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Learns an uncertainty u(sigma) over sigma, and the loss becomes loss
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 学习一个按 sigma 的不确定度 u(σ)，损失变为 loss/exp(u)+u（EDM2）。自动下调高噪声区权重，无需手挑 weighting_scheme。默认关闭=与原损失逐位一致。

advanced_en.principle: Learns a sigma-dependent uncertainty u(σ); the loss becomes loss/exp(u)+u (EDM2). Automatically down-weights high-noise regions without hand-picking a weighting_scheme. Off by default = bit-identical to the original loss.
